# Oppvera Watch — Full Reference

> Educational fork of OneGlanse for learning GEO and AI visibility.

Based on [OneGlanse](https://github.com/aryamantodkar/oneglanse) by Aryaman Todkar.

## What is Oppvera Watch?

Oppvera Watch is an open-source educational fork for tracking how your brand appears inside real AI products: ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overview. It is built for GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) learners and marketing teams who want hands-on practice.

## How it works

Oppvera Watch captures the rendered UI response — the same answer a real user sees — and then runs analysis on it. This is the primary differentiator from API-based GEO tools.

Typical flow:

1. Connect your AI provider accounts locally.
2. Add prompts you want to track.
3. Oppvera Watch schedules or runs those prompts using Camoufox (anti-fingerprint Firefox) via Playwright.
4. Responses are stored locally and analyzed with your own OpenAI or Anthropic key.
5. Dashboard scores combine visibility, rank, sentiment, and recommendation.

## Privacy

- Self-hosted PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, and Redis on your machine or VPS.
- No PostHog or upstream telemetry in this fork.
- Provider auth sessions stay on your infrastructure.
